purpose: Teach: 射程/救世主/宮廷/攻防/急落/惹き/激動/無念

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、ミサイルの射程に関する、安全保障の議論、本気で、論じていましたね、本当に、印象的でした、絶対、立派、本気。
lines.en: Ren, your paper on missile-range security policy was genuinely impressive. The depth of your argument was really striking.
lines.style: Warm, measured delivery with genuine admiration. Lean forward slightly with eyes steady. Pace unhurried — giving each thought room. Slight pause before 'really striking' to emphasize sincerity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史上、救世主のような、指導者の役割、論文で、本気で、扱いました、絶対、本気で、深い、研究、できました、本当に。
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to treat the role of these historic leader-figures seriously in the research — to go deep into how they shaped their times.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude with underlying effort beneath the words. Slight tension in the shoulders — this matters to him. Even pacing, careful. No rush to fill silence after finishing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平安時代の宮廷、本気で、印象的な、文化が、栄えていましたね、論文で、扱っていました、絶対、本気で、立派、本当に、感心。
lines.en: The Heian court section was striking too — the way you traced how that cultural flourishing actually functioned. Really thoughtful scope.
lines.style: Conversational but deliberate. Slight nod on 'really thoughtful' — acknowledging his work without over-praising. Warm but not effusive. Breath easy, natural pauses.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の権力の攻防、本気で、複雑でしたよね、論文で、丁寧に、扱いました、絶対、深い、研究、できました、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Thank you. The power dynamics of that era were genuinely complex — I tried to be careful with how I handled all those competing interests.
lines.style: Modest but not self-diminishing. Eyes down briefly on 'complex' — thinking through it again. Then back up. Steady, almost conversational tone. Not performing gratitude.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 江戸時代、社会的地位の急落、武家でも、ありましたね、論文で、扱っていました、絶対、本気で、視野、広い、本当に、立派、絶対。
lines.en: And the Edo period analysis — how status could collapse so suddenly, even for samurai families — that showed real range in your thinking.
lines.style: Nod of genuine recognition. Slower pace here — sitting with the significance of that insight. Warm in the eyes. Not lecturing, but teacher-to-student respect visible.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。物語の魅力、人々を惹きつける力、本気で、扱いました、絶対、本気で、深い、考察、できました、本当に、感謝、しております、本気。
lines.en: That actually came from looking at the stories from that time — how they drew people in, what they revealed about what mattered to those people. I'm genuinely grateful for the chance to do this work.
lines.style: Quieter here — almost reflective. Breath a little lighter. Hands maybe folded. Not looking away, but inward for a moment. Gratitude that's real, not performed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治の激動の時代、本気で、論文の核心、テーマでしたね、絶対、桜さん、本気で、立派、本当に、感心しました、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: The Meiji period really was your paper's heart, wasn't it? That turbulent era — you brought such clarity to it. It was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Lean back slightly — summary moment, stepping back to see the whole picture. Warm but firmer conviction on 'genuinely impressive.' Slower, more emphatic delivery. Real respect in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。志半ばで、無念に、亡くなった人物、論文で、扱いました、絶対、本気で、心が、痛む、内容でした、本当に、本気で、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. Those figures who died before they could finish what they started — I wanted to honor that kind of tragedy in how I treated it. It was painful to write, actually.
lines.style: Quieter, more vulnerable. Slight tremor possible underneath — this moved him. Pace slows on 'painful to write.' Eyes up to meet hers with genuine openness. Not hiding the feeling.
